procedures.summary: Keep observations, correlations, hypotheses and reviewed conclusions distinct.
procedures.content: Use only host-returned events and source references as observations. Describe rule-derived links as correlations and retain the rule and evidence references. Record proposed explanations as hypotheses. Promote a claim to a reviewed conclusion only after an analyst review decision; preserve contradictions, missing coverage and clock uncertainty.

procedures.summary: Respect configured sources, case scope, time windows and analysis budgets.
procedures.content: Use only sources configured by the host and available in the current namespace or project scope. Keep collection within the case time window and declared budgets. Treat truncated, timed-out or approximate search results as partial. Never infer that a missing event proves an event did not occur.

procedures.summary: Trace an identity through authenticated destinations and nearby events.
procedures.content: Start with an exact user identifier, collect within the case window, then inspect authenticated_to relations and the source events behind each relation. Compare event times and host identity domains. Treat account-name matches across sources as separate unless the source supplies a stable shared identity.

procedures.summary: Trace observed communication while retaining direction and source evidence.
procedures.content: Start from a host or address, expand observed communication relations, inspect the supporting flow events, and compare source/destination fields and time coverage. A network edge establishes recorded communication only; it does not establish propagation, control or causality.

procedures.summary: Construct a time-ordered event chain with explicit clock limits.
procedures.content: Use the bounded temporal_path analysis for a candidate start and target. The host requires relation intervals to be time-compatible. Preserve unknown timestamps, uncertainty and clock limitations; a missing edge is not proof that the event did not occur.

procedures.summary: Follow trace and message identifiers across integration events.
procedures.content: Use exact trace, span, correlation or message identifiers as the join key. Inspect the source event for each step and keep service-to-service ordering bounded by observed timestamps. Do not merge different identifiers based only on similar names or proximity in time.

procedures.summary: Test a proposed explanation against supporting and contradicting events.
procedures.content: State the claim as a hypothesis. Search for evidence that supports it and evidence that would contradict it, record limitations and alternative explanations, and leave the claim unreviewed. Only an analyst can decide whether a conclusion is accepted.

procedures.summary: Freeze a source-linked report from one exact case revision.
procedures.content: Confirm the case revision, then use investigation.report.compose. Preserve event ordering, rule IDs, evidence references, hypothesis state and gaps. The report is a frozen resource; further analysis creates a later case revision and a separately composed report.

blueprints.selection_description: Trace an identity through hosts and authentication events.
blueprints.purpose: Establish which configured sources record authentication activity for the selected identity.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked account of observed authentication destinations and related events.
blueprints.success_criteria: Every stated destination is supported by retained source events; uncertain identity bindings and coverage gaps remain explicit.

steps.title: Select scope
steps.objective: Confirm the identity, source and case time window.

steps.title: Collect events
steps.objective: Collect a bounded page matching the exact identity.

steps.title: Inspect relations
steps.objective: Expand authentication relations and read their source events.

steps.title: Report findings
steps.objective: Separate observed destinations from hypotheses and gaps.

blueprints.selection_description: Trace observed network communication from a host or address.
blueprints.purpose: Describe source-linked communication paths and their time coverage.
blueprints.goal: Identify the observed peers and supporting flow records for the selected host or address.
blueprints.success_criteria: Relations retain their derivation rule and event evidence; communication is not presented as causation.

steps.title: Select scope
steps.objective: Confirm the host/address, network source and time range.

steps.title: Collect flow events
steps.objective: Collect bounded source/destination records.

steps.title: Expand peers
steps.objective: Inspect graph peers and the evidence records behind each relation.

steps.title: Qualify coverage
steps.objective: Report direction, time coverage, truncation and non-causal limits.

blueprints.selection_description: Find a bounded time-compatible chain between two entities.
blueprints.purpose: Test whether recorded relations form a time-ordered path under explicit bounds.
blueprints.goal: Return a bounded shortest-hop temporal path or an explicit no-path/budget-limited result.
blueprints.success_criteria: Every path edge has source events and compatible event times; incomplete searches are marked partial.

steps.title: Define endpoints
steps.objective: Select start, target and earliest allowed event time.

steps.title: Collect relations
steps.objective: Collect only source records needed to build candidate edges.

steps.title: Search chain
steps.objective: Run bounded temporal path analysis.

steps.title: Inspect proof
steps.objective: Read supporting events and state optimality and clock limitations.

blueprints.selection_description: Follow an exact trace, correlation or message identifier across services.
blueprints.purpose: Reconstruct an integration path from source events that share a stable trace identifier.
blueprints.goal: Describe the observed service/event sequence with its timestamps and source evidence.
blueprints.success_criteria: The path uses exact identifier matches, preserves missing spans and does not invent unobserved service transitions.

steps.title: Select identifier
steps.objective: Confirm exact trace/correlation/message ID and source.

steps.title: Collect spans
steps.objective: Collect a bounded page of exact identifier matches.

steps.title: Order events
steps.objective: Build and inspect the observed time-ordered service path.

steps.title: State gaps
steps.objective: Identify missing spans, clocks and unsupported transitions.

blueprints.selection_description: Evaluate a testable claim against supporting and contradicting evidence.
blueprints.purpose: Keep an explanation as a hypothesis until an analyst reviews the evidence.
blueprints.goal: Record a hypothesis with both supporting and contradicting source references and explicit limitations.
blueprints.success_criteria: The claim remains a hypothesis; model output never records an analyst review decision.

steps.title: State claim
steps.objective: Write a testable explanation and identify alternatives.

steps.title: Seek support
steps.objective: Collect events that would support the claim.

steps.title: Seek contradictions
steps.objective: Collect events that would challenge the claim.

steps.title: Record hypothesis
steps.objective: Store evidence references and limitations without reviewing the claim.

blueprints.selection_description: Freeze a report from a selected investigation case revision.
blueprints.purpose: Create an auditable report resource tied to one immutable case revision.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked report containing a timeline, relations, hypotheses and coverage limitations.
blueprints.success_criteria: The report URI and content fingerprint identify a frozen case revision; later analysis does not rewrite it.

steps.title: Confirm revision
steps.objective: Open the exact case revision to freeze.

steps.title: Compose report
steps.objective: Create the frozen source-linked report resource.

steps.title: Review report
steps.objective: Check evidence references, claim states and gaps.

artifact_profiles.title: Investigation report
artifact_profiles.purpose: Present one immutable case revision with traceable evidence, supported and contradicted claims, and explicit gaps.
